title: "Welcome" gets struck out
concept: A homepage cliché is blown past the edges of the frame and struck out until one concrete sentence survives. Invented example: a bicycle repair shop.
hook: Delete the word "Welcome" from your homepage.
signature_move: The strike bar bends down and becomes the underline of the one sentence that survives.

captions.instagram:
Delete the word "Welcome" from your homepage.

Every business site opens with a sentence that could belong to anyone. A visitor reads it, learns nothing and moves on.

Say what you do instead. "We fix bikes while you wait" tells a stranger more than three lines about passion and quality. (An invented example, not a real shop.)

What does the first sentence on your homepage say?
